learning_outcomes.text: To define the direct current and alternating current electric circuit.
To use the Kirchoff's current and voltage laws and Ohm's law,are used in circuit analysis,in the electrical circuits.
To define the Circuit analysis methods; superposition, loop currents, node voltages,Thevenin and Norton equivalents and to use all of them.
To define the Power,energy and their calculation. Calculate the the maximum power transfer accounts.
To Define the control systems with electrical circuits

syllabus_topics: Basic Concepts and Definitions in Electricity
Fundamental laws of circuit analysis: Kirchoff's Current and Voltage Laws.
Resistive Network Analysis: Voltage Nodes and Mesh Currents. Principle of Superposition.
Thevenin and Norton Equivalent Circuits. Maximum Power Transfer. Nonlinear Loads and Load-Line Analysis.
AC Circuits excited by sinusoidal voltages and currents. Dynamic Circuits Elements: Capacitors and Inductors.
The solution of circuit differential equations in terms of KVL and KCL. Phasor Analysis and Concept of Impedance.
Calculation of basic parameters with phasors and complex numbers.

Effect of Coil and Capacity in Alternating Current Circuits:Capacity and Coil definitions, Resistance-Capacitance, Resistance-inductance, and resistance-inductance-capacity Serial / Parallel Circuits.
Op-Amp, Feedback and Control: The Ideal Op-Amp Circuits, General Feedback and Control and its applications.
Electricity and Electromagnetism: The subject of Magnetic Field, Electromagnetism and Electromagnetic Induction
The basics of Power System ;Electric transformers, DC and AC motors
